title: A piece's content in one language — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a piece's `content.<language>.yaml` (DEC-001 point 3, DEC-002 point 4): its top component's fields. The one schema of the capability that is not strict at schema level, since the components the content fills declare its fields: the capability's check judges the content against them, naming the nearest known key. Here, each key at the top is a name or a reserved key, and the methodology's container `pkit` is a mapping the capability never reads. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:content`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).
